rows.name: Clear goal and feedback
rows.note: hero walks, cards placed, loop counter; lapse: many card synergies are undocumented

rows.name: Interesting decisions
rows.note: every card placement is a trade of danger for resources; retreat-or-push at the camp tile; lapse: late game has a known optimal layout

rows.name: Mastery curve
rows.note: learning tile adjacency (village+vampire, mountain 3x3); lapse: plateaus once known

rows.name: Tension, risk and release
rows.note: one more loop with 30% HP and the boss bar filling; lapse: mid-boss fights are stat checks

rows.name: Surprise and variety
rows.note: tile combos spawn new tiles and enemies; lapse: chapter 3-4 repeats

rows.name: Expression and identity
rows.note: your loop is a map you drew; class builds; lapse: convergent gear

rows.name: Story to tell
rows.note: runs produce anecdotes about a bad tile placement; the narrative frame is thin

rows.name: Flow and pacing
rows.note: runs are 15-40 min at 2x; camp-building check-ins are quick; lapse: late-chapter grind for resources

rows.name: Fairness and legibility of failure
rows.note: death shows the fight and the loop; retreat keeps 60/30%; lapse: some deaths are card RNG

rows.name: Collection and progression
rows.note: camp unlocks add new cards and classes, i.e. new decisions; lapse: resource grind

rows.name: Return payoff (idle)
rows.note: you can leave it looping but the game does not reward absence; the camp is the return payoff

rows.name: Attribution of the agent's play (idle)
rows.note: the hero died because I placed a lantern next to a spider cocoon; lapse: equipment auto-fight has no player input
